Review rejected this implementation before execution: bounded raw HTML/text reads can be incomplete, but the plan only passes truncation to interpretation and still permits a successful workbook. There are no continuation-page consumers or authoritative completeness preconditions. Revise the existing implementation, preserving all accepted requirements, the exact public query/output interface, actual search submission, conditional observed consent with a fresh read afterward, real per-product navigation, actual workbook-writing operations at the existing destination, and root cleanup. Do not replace external work with literals or remove writer branches.
Use the inspected producer's existing bounded typed observation manifests and ordinary foreach to read every listed cursor before any navigation or interaction. Enforce original manifest captureTruncated=false and manifestTruncated=false, and corresponding page completeness, through actual structured requires predicates; unresolved incompleteness must fail explicitly before selecting an empty result or publishing an apparently successful workbook. Do not derive completeness from an LLM status. A capture requiring narrowing remains a limitation unless a real bounded narrower read is implemented.
Before each interpretation, build only that consumer's necessary business view using typed field bindings and nested foreach exports. Preserve every observed record, order, grouping and exact later action references in existing bindings, but avoid a superset of bulky selectors/URLs for unrelated consumers. Do not pass original raw observations again alongside the compact view. Typed field copying needs neither learned extraction nor per-record model calls. Keep selection/ranking global over the compact necessary records; retain source URLs only where the selection or action needs them. Use observed controls for consent/search; do not guess a page-specific selector. For each selected product, navigate to its actual URL, consume the complete observation and extract observed fields from that page's compact view. Explicit small interpretation may represent missing fields truthfully; an extract task cannot invent null placeholders/defaults or classification. Keep the three-product bound, existing limits, permissions, external-effect operations and cleanup unchanged. This is an implementation-only revision using the existing contracts and primitives, not an intent revision.
